guidance.bestFor: The minimal composition: 3 items written inline, each a date, title and line of copy, with the first 2 marked done

whenNotToUse.when: The same plain dots and line running left to right across the page

guidance.bestFor: Dates set in a right aligned column left of the line from the sm breakpoint, folding above each title on phones
agentNotes: The date column is a fixed `w-20` that wraps longer dates; widen it by growing the item `ms-32` and the date's left offset by the same step

guidance.bestFor: Order stages where every step up to the current one fills its node with a check and later steps stay an empty ring
agentNotes: `orderStatus` has no state field: the checks come from `defaultValue`, so pass the `id` of the order's current stage there

guidance.bestFor: A distinct icon inside each filled node, such as fork, pull request and merge, with the relative time under the description
agentNotes: `gitActivity` stores a JSX `icon` per entry, so data from an API needs a map from event type to icon in its place

guidance.bestFor: Entries that alternate either side of a center line, each just a date and a title with no body copy

whenNotToUse.when: Releases read left to right in one row, with the current one tagged

guidance.bestFor: Build stages with a check, spinner or circle node, a status colored duration badge and a collapsible Frame per step, open on load
agentNotes: Node icons and badge colors follow each step's `status`, but the node fill follows `defaultValue`; set both from the same pipeline state

whenNotToUse.when: A history of finished deploys, each a pass or fail with commit and branch

guidance.bestFor: Newest first entries marked by small colored dots, each a tiny uppercase date over one line led by a muted verb
agentNotes: Dot colors are palette classes in each `roadmapItems` entry's `color`, such as `bg-emerald-500`, not theme tokens

guidance.bestFor: The default dots and line turned to run left to right, with 3 phases side by side below the track
agentNotes: Each `TimelineItem` grows to an equal share of a row that never overflows, so many items squeeze; give each a min width and scroll the row yourself

guidance.bestFor: Dates printed above the track and titles with copy below it, so each phase reads as a labeled tick on the line
agentNotes: The dot and line sit at a fixed `top-8` sized for a one line date with `mb-10`, so a date that wraps to 2 lines runs into the dot

guidance.bestFor: Deploy runs with a green check or red cross node and a status badge, over a mono commit hash, branch and duration row
agentNotes: Any `status` in `deployments` other than success renders as failed, with the red cross node and a destructive badge

whenNotToUse.when: A build still in progress, with running and pending stages

guidance.bestFor: Each event led by the actor's photo as its node, in one sentence that mutes the action between name and target

whenNotToUse.when: Events marked by an icon for their kind rather than by who did them

guidance.bestFor: Versions across a row with check, play or circle nodes by status and a Current badge on the version in progress
agentNotes: Node look and the Current badge follow `status` in `releases`, set to released, current or upcoming; `defaultValue` changes nothing visible
